preconditions.description: The length of the permutation is at least 1 and at most 50000.
The value of k is such that 2k is less than or equal to the length of the permutation.

postconditions.description: The permutation a has a length of 2n.

postconditions.expression: all(a[i] != a[j] for i < j for i, j in range(2 * n))
postconditions.description: All elements in the permutation a are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= 2 * n for i in range(2 * n))
postconditions.description: Each element in the permutation a is a positive integer no larger than 2n.

postconditions.expression: sum(abs(a[2 * i - 1] - a[2 * i]) for i in range(1, n + 1)) - abs(sum(a[2 * i - 1] for i in range(1, n + 1)) - sum(a[2 * i] for i in range(1, n + 1))) == 2 * k
postconditions.description: The permutation a satisfies the given equation.
